record.question: The proviso to Rule 10 (7) of the CCS (CCA) Rules, 1965 provides that review of suspension shall not be necessary if the Government servant continues to be under suspension due to:
options: detention in custody, whether on a criminal charge or otherwise.
a disciplinary proceeding against him is contemplated or is pending.
a case against him in respect of any criminal offence is under investigation, inquiry or trial
engagement in activities prejudicial to the interest of the security of the state.
